case.pattern_description: The online transaction occurred from a new device profile with a transparent proxy flag, closely mirroring historical confirmed fraud cases for this account.
case.summary: Case HHG-017 involved a $100.09 card-not-present transaction made from a new device, triggering an initial fraud probability score of 0.95. Although the device fingerprint was generic and shared across many cards, customer validation confirmed that the cardholder neither made the purchase nor relinquished possession of the card. Based on this customer denial, the card was blocked and the case was officially closed with a verdict of confirmed fraud.
